prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create one portrait 3:4 premium photorealistic catalogue photograph for 128am Cafe, not a collage.
Use both provided local reference photos as the physical product identity source: image 1 MATCHA LATTE in a short broad clear plastic cup with slightly tapered sides, flat clear lid and white seal under the rim, dark green matcha at top grading into pale green and a thin white milk bottom; image 2 STRAWBERRY MATCHA LATTE in a short broad clear plastic cup with clear dome lid, natural green matcha/milk marbling, pale milk below and deep red strawberry bottom layer. Retain both real cup shapes/proportions, lids and fills exactly; brighten and colour-correct appetisingly without changing recipe. Preserve each front mascot sticker faithfully: cute dark-haired girl with pink bow beside a white bunny with exactly two ears, the 128am Cafe lettering, same compact sticker artwork and scale. Products themselves must remain realistic clear plastic photographed with real light, never an illustration or ceramic tumbler.
Scene: asymmetrical editorial diagonal product composition in a polished warm cream photography studio. MATCHA stands at back-left, smaller through natural depth perspective; STRAWBERRY stands closer to camera at front-right, larger. Their positions create a diagonal from upper-left to lower-right across the image. Both cups must stay perfectly upright on one flat matte cream surface, not tilted or levitating. Both complete cups, both lids and both front stickers visible with no cup obscuring the other sticker. Camera slightly elevated, 85mm editorial food photograph look; crisp physical product detail, credible soft directional shadows to lower-left, bright neutral-warm studio lighting. Muted sage vertical flat panel at distant left edge, blush curve softly blurred at distant right edge. Spacious cream area above and between cups, striking magazine-like asymmetry with clear type placement.
Graphics: generous uncluttered upper space. Fredoka-style bold rounded lowercase rose #B8496C type. Put exact heading "matcha latte" next to the back-left matcha cup in nearby upper-left negative space, and exact heading "strawberry matcha latte" next to the front-right strawberry cup in right upper/middle negative space. Both labels should be clearly adjacent to their correct cup with tidy line breaks and no overlap. Small "128am Cafe" at top centre. Palette cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, subtle blush #FDE5EB and sage #E7F0DC. Typography consistent across a premium café catalogue. No other text, no prices, no claims, no watermark, no added toppings or fruit, no straw, no hands. ONE completed photograph.
